# pve_filerestore_download (Action)

Download one file from a backup volume via file-restore.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_filerestore_download" "example" {
  config {
  filepath = "CHANGE_ME"
  node = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
  volume = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_filerestore_download.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filepath` (String) base64-path to the directory or file to download.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.
- `volume` (String) Backup volume ID or name. Currently only PBS snapshots are supported.

### Optional

- `tar` (Boolean) Download dirs as 'tar.zst' instead of 'zip'. (default: 0)
